holonomy_reduction.connected_reason: The base K3 is simply connected.
holonomy_reduction.irreducible_reason: Stability makes the HYM connection irreducible.
holonomy_reduction.semisimple_reason: A connected center acts by scalars, but connected scalars inside SU9 are trivial.

irreducible_dimension_nine_classificatio.completeness: Weyl dimension bounds leave only A1, A8 and B4 in the simple case; 9=3*3 is the only nontrivial semisimple product factorization.
irreducible_dimension_nine_classificatio.proper_product_case: two irreducible three-dimensional factors in a tensor product

SO9.K3_parity: rho2(p1)=w2^2=0 because every integral lift has even square in the K3 lattice

three_by_three_tensor.importance: The twisted Mukai bound excludes even nonliftable projective factors, so no zero-Brauer assumption is used.

theorem.name: PrimeElevenRankNineFullHolonomyTheorem
theorem.statement: Every stable rank-nine bundle on the selected K3 with trivial determinant and c2=11 has full SU9 HYM holonomy. The SO9, Sym8(SU2), and possibly Brauer-twisted 3x3 tensor reductions are excluded respectively by K3 parity and sharp stable-(twisted)-Mukai discriminant bounds.
